_about: W. G. Rutherford (1853-1907), headmaster of Westminster: The New Phrynichus (1881), a revised text of the Atticist grammarian's Ecloga with introductions and an English commentary. Greek-heavy; kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling. His Babrius scan has an empty text layer; his grammars, sermons and St Paul translations are outside lane B. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dj). Raw IA OCR. No uids minted. Also raw IA: Babrius, edited with introductory dissertations, critical notes, commentary and lexicon (Macmillan, 1883), Greek-heavy, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling. Round dw (2026-10-23) added, raw IA OCR with title pages read: First Greek Grammar (2nd ed., 1888); Thucydides IV, a revision of the text (1889); First Greek Syntax (1890); Scholia Aristophanica, arranged, emended and translated, 3 vols (1896-1905); St. Paul's Epistle to the Romans, a new translation (1900); St. Paul's Epistles to the Thessalonians and Corinthians, a new translation (1908). Greek-dense volumes kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling.
